<thought>Based on the dominant mass‑spectrometry peak at m/z 276.0666, the most plausible molecular formula that matches this exact mass is C₁₄H₁₂O₆. This formula gives a calculated monoisotopic mass of 276.0634 Da, which is within experimental error of the observed value.</thought>
<final_answer>C14H12O6</final_answer>
